text.p: AT&T Corp said Monday that it began distributing to its shareholders the approximately 525 million shares of common stock in Lucent Technologies currently held by AT&T, which will finalize the spin-off of Lucent today.

The distribution and spin-off, which is part of AT&T's plan to restructure itself into three separate businesses, will result in AT&T shareholders receiving about 82.4 percent of the outstanding shares of Lucent Technologies' common stock.
Lucent Technologies went public with an initial public offering of its stock in April.

As previously announced, the distribution is on the basis of .324084 of a share of Lucent for each AT&T share outstanding. In July, the AT&T board declared this special stock dividend to AT&T shareholders of record on September 17.

AT&T also said that after Monday's market close, the New York Stock Exchange expects to end trading AT&T shares "without distribution," which has occurred over the past two weeks in addition to AT&T's "regular way" (shares trading under the symbol T.N). The two forms of trading have represented the value of AT&T either including or excluding Lucent Technologies.
On October 1, AT&T shares will no longer include Lucent's value.
